scope: Checked path inputs before parsing the first form or a newly referenced metadata file

implementation.preparation: form/prepare validates selected owner/application and resolves active source roots plus composing form locations without parsing their XML
implementation.inputs: Open/update accept existing contained XML paths with dirty text or query buffer; validation runs on every request
implementation.sourceIds: Relative path components are normalized before hashing; opaque IDs stay stable across content changes
implementation.unusedMetadata: Checked metadata candidates not needed by this form are not parsed or retained as dependencies
implementation.foreignInputs: Other-owner Form.xml, foreign roots, traversal, BSL and duplicate paths rejected
implementation.legacy: ID overlays and API 1.36/1.37 clients remain supported; new Viewer requires 1.38 preparation capability
implementation.inlineTransfer: Conservative packet inline budget is separate from Unicode-safe chunk size
implementation.lifecycleGuards: Closed or suspended views cannot install late preparation watchers or retain a late allocated form session

testCorrections: Native initial-form scenario explicitly focuses the main workbench and waits for the XML editor; a floating window may have no activeTextEditor
Initial invalid-file recovery waits for an active watcher and settled failure, rather than the old private watchKey string
Two integration expectations for the current server minor were updated from 37 to 38
remaining: Valid manifests and root descriptors are still required to resolve project/application ownership
XML file events and new dirty XML within active roots conservatively refresh open forms; T164 measurement and dependency refinement remain
Dedicated reload/restart/DPI and pending-close race acceptance in T162/T163 remains
Independent Windows acceptance, including path spelling/aliases
Full visual parity and the other open T152–T165 work
